steps.text: keyboard-wizard-ce: key.keyboard_wizard_ce.openKeyWizard (KEYSYM 296, F7) opens KeyWizardScreen, whose filterBindingsByName tests I18n.get(mapping.getName()).toLowerCase().contains(typed token)

keyboard-wizard-ce: searchBar = new EditBox(font, 10, height-20, maxNameWidth+20, 14) added through addRenderableWidget and never focused by init, so on the run's 640x360 GUI space it is 10..10+w x 340..354; 25,347 is inside it for any w the key names produce
keyboard-wizard-ce: type the pinyin of key.forward's zh_cn name; the versions disagree on whether it reads 前进 or 向前移动, and both contain 前, so the query and the assertion stay on that shared character
keyboard-wizard-ce: the list re-filters from KeyWizardScreen.tick() -> KeyBindingListWidget.updateList() whenever the box's value changes, so the recorder fills within a couple of ticks
